query: How do I fetch the next page of results when browsing the pet catalog?
expected_anchor: pass the nextCursor value from the previous

query: What happens if I wait too long between page requests while listing pets?
expected_anchor: Cursors expire after fifteen minutes

query: How are calls to the pet store service authenticated?
expected_anchor: Authentication uses the X-Api-Key header

query: Why can't I remove a pet that someone has an outstanding purchase for?
expected_anchor: the server responds with 409 Conflict

query: How can a client tell a pet id that never existed apart from one that was taken off the catalog?
expected_anchor: return 410 Gone rather than 404

query: How long does a buyer have to pay before their pet order is voided?
expected_anchor: automatically cancelled after 48 hours

query: If my capture request times out and I resend it with the same key, will the customer be charged twice?
expected_anchor: returns the original result without charging

query: Why would creating a charge come back with a payment-required failure?
expected_anchor: the card issuer declined the charge

query: How does my server find out that a cardholder has started a chargeback?
expected_anchor: delivered to every registered webhook endpoint

query: Can I give back only part of what the customer originally paid?
expected_anchor: up to the remaining un-refunded amount

query: What is the safe way to retry creating a charge after a network failure?
expected_anchor: retried creates are deduplicated

query: How many calls per minute can I make to the legacy reporting service before it throttles me?
expected_anchor: limited to 120 requests per minute per token

query: Which row-count field in report responses should new integrations stop using?
expected_anchor: the legacy totalRows field is deprecated

query: How do I know when my CSV export has finished and where to get the file?
expected_anchor: becomes complete, then follow the downloadUrl

query: Is it possible for two accounts to sign up with the same email address?
expected_anchor: must be unique across all active customers

query: When a customer account is deleted, is the record actually erased from storage?
expected_anchor: deletedAt is set instead of removing the row

query: How are postal codes checked when a customer saves an address?
expected_anchor: must match the national format of the country

query: Which address fields do I have to provide no matter which country the customer lives in?
expected_anchor: line1 and countryCode are always required

query: What retry behavior do failed pipeline jobs get if the config file doesn't set one?
expected_anchor: defaults to 3 attempts when omitted

query: Can my settings file pull secrets from the process environment instead of hardcoding them?
expected_anchor: reference environment variables with the ${VAR_NAME} syntax

query: Which verbosity settings does the logging section of the config accept?
expected_anchor: one of debug, info, warn, or error

query: Do units being held for open orders count toward what the storefront can sell?
expected_anchor: reserved units are excluded from availableQuantity

query: What characters and length are allowed in a product's stock identifier?
expected_anchor: uppercase letters, digits, and hyphens only

query: When does the system decide an item needs restocking?
expected_anchor: falls at or below reorderPoint

query: which event fires after checkout payment is authorized
expected_anchor: Emitted once per checkout after payment authorization succeeds.

query: how do consumers release reserved warehouse stock when an order is cancelled
expected_anchor: Consume cancellations to release reserved warehouse stock.

query: how do I request a stock reservation for the lines of an order
expected_anchor: Request a warehouse stock reservation for the order lines.

query: what does the order placed message represent
expected_anchor: A customer completed checkout and payment was authorized.

query: which channel carries periodic sensor readings from field devices
expected_anchor: High-volume channel carrying periodic sensor readings from field devices.

query: when do devices publish their telemetry reading batches
expected_anchor: Devices publish batched sensor readings every reporting interval.

query: what causes a threshold alert to be raised
expected_anchor: Raised on-device when a measurement crosses its configured threshold.

query: what is the warehouse hint on a reservation used for
expected_anchor: Preferred fulfilment warehouse for split-shipment decisions.

query: how do I look up a single product by its slug
expected_anchor: Look up a single product by its URL-safe slug

query: does product search support category filtering
expected_anchor: Full-text search over product titles and descriptions with category filters.

query: how do I add a product variant to the shopping cart
expected_anchor: Add a quantity of one product variant to the visitor's cart.

query: what does the cart subtotal include
expected_anchor: Sum of line subtotals before shipping and tax

query: how do I page through the staff audit trail
expected_anchor: Paginated audit trail of staff actions, newest first.

query: how can support staff find a customer account by email
expected_anchor: Look up a customer account by email for support investigations.

query: what does the locked flag on a customer account mean
expected_anchor: Whether the account is currently locked by fraud review.

query: when does the fraud pipeline lock an account automatically
expected_anchor: Locked automatically by the fraud scoring pipeline.

query: how do I fetch one user by account id
expected_anchor: Fetch one user by stable account id; returns NOT_FOUND for purged accounts.

query: what happens when a user account is deactivated
expected_anchor: Soft-delete an account and schedule purge after the retention window.

query: are account identifiers ever reused after purge
expected_anchor: Stable account identifier, never reused after purge.

query: which account state is allowed to authenticate
expected_anchor: Active and allowed to authenticate.

query: when is the purge job allowed to run after deactivation
expected_anchor: When the retention window ends and the purge job may run.

query: what does the on hand quantity in the stock ledger mean
expected_anchor: Units physically on the shelf at the last count.

query: what does reserved stock mean in the warehouse ledger
expected_anchor: Units promised to open orders but not yet picked.

query: how are picks and receipts signed in a stock adjustment
expected_anchor: Signed quantity: negative for picks, positive for receipts.
